goalDescription: Die lernende Person kann Zahlungsarten nach Sicherheit, Kosten, Verfügbarkeit und Zweckmäßigkeit situationsbezogen vergleichen und auswählen.
reviewerModel: Codex; exact serving model identifier not exposed
aspectRatioDecision: Close native16:9 landscape; no exception needed. Format not mechanically normalized.

actualInspection.fachlichePruefung: The same learner uses cash, a bank card and a digital phone checkout in different circumstances. Security, cost and availability icons form a situation-dependent question rather than assigning one universally best method.
actualInspection.phone: At 360 px three methods, large labels and shared situation/question motif remain recognisable; no small account or card data must be read.
actualInspection.desktop: At 680 px cash handover, card terminal and phone checkout are distinctly visible, each connected with an open criterion question.
actualInspection.actorPerspective: The terminal faces the payer and the phone is held so its display faces its user's eyes. The audience sees a plausible oblique view, not a display on the reverse side.
actualInspection.style: Friendly clear comic raster, coherent broad colors and approachable people without photorealism or sterile technical restyling.

interpretationLimits: Card payment is itself digital in a technical sense; the panels depict selected practical payment situations, not mutually exclusive exhaustive technology categories. Security icons are comparison criteria, not safety guarantees.
goalTextStatus: Actual current canonical German title/description inspected; no D/P gate attested by this image review.
